day_profiles_dynamic_ck.name: day_profiles_dynamic_ck
day_profiles_dynamic_ck.value: "day_profiles"."deficit_kcal" between -1500 and 1500 and "day_profiles"."protein_g_per_kg" between 0 and 4 and "day_profiles"."fat_g_per_kg" between 0 and 3

day_activity_amounts_ck.name: day_activity_amounts_ck
day_activity_amounts_ck.value: coalesce("day_activity"."walking_min", 0) between 0 and 1440 and coalesce("day_activity"."steps", 0) between 0 and 100000

sets_measure_ck.name: sets_measure_ck
sets_measure_ck.value: "sets"."reps" is not null or "sets"."duration_s" is not null

sets_positive_ck.name: sets_positive_ck
sets_positive_ck.value: coalesce("sets"."reps", 1) > 0 and coalesce("sets"."load_kg", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("sets"."duration_s", 1) > 0 and coalesce("sets"."distance_m", 0) >= 0
